priorityProperties: No claim can be redirected, replayed, or exceed its allocation.
No campaign can release more assets than it was fully funded to distribute.
A guardian cannot execute or withdraw funds, and an owner cannot bypass a queued governance delay.
An API or agent key cannot exceed project, scope, amount, event, or human-approval policy.
Raw recipient identities and authentication secrets never appear in public responses, logs, evidence, or onchain state.
Release, venue, and adapter attestations fail closed when runtime bytecode differs.
excluded: Third-party Circle, Arc RPC, CCTP, Gateway, OAuth provider, and liquidity venue implementations
